task: Pick up the CUP and place it on the TABLE.
plan_summary: Navigate CAR to CUP, pick it up, then navigate to TABLE and place CUP on it
assumptions: CAR robot starts at (0,0) and can navigate to CUP at (2,2) and TABLE at (-2,2)
CUP is graspable and within interaction distance after navigation
TABLE is within interaction distance for placing after navigation
Navigation tolerance of 0.5 is sufficient for pick and place operations
rtdl: def task PickAndPlaceCup(;){ state nav_to_cup_success: bool; state nav_to_cup_msg: string; state pick_success: bool; state pick_msg: string; state nav_to_table_success: bool; state nav_to_table_msg: string; state place_success: bool; state place_msg: string; sequence{ do NavTo(robot_name="CAR",x=2.0,y=2.0,tolerance=0.5;success->nav_to_cup_success,message->nav_to_cup_msg); check(nav_to_cup_success == true); do Pick(robot_name="CAR",object_name="CUP";success->pick_success,message->pick_msg); check(pick_success == true); do NavTo(robot_name="CAR",x=-1.9996420034862905,y=1.9999985754738918,tolerance=0.5;success->nav_to_table_success,message->nav_to_table_msg); check(nav_to_table_success == true); do Place(robot_name="CAR",object_name="CUP",location_name="TABLE";success->place_success,message->place_msg); check(place_success == true); } }
